request.question: Does the NEW requirement change, replace, restrict, extend or withdraw any part of the EXISTING register item (i.e. they govern the same behaviour and the new one alters it)?
request.background: NEW requirement: Confidential records may now also be exported when user['role'] is 'admin' and params.get('purpose') == 'regulator'.

items.text: CURRENT [S1.1, S2.3, S3.1, S4.2] Format: return CSV text. The first row is the header id,title,owner,amount; then one row per exported record, in ascending id order, with those four fields. Produce it with Python's csv.writer (default dialect) and lineterminator='\n'. With no exported records, return the header row alone (ending in '\n'). || AMENDED by S2.3 (wins on conflict; rest stays): Titles: export each record's title with leading and trailing whitespace removed. || AMENDED by S3.1 (wins on conflict; rest stays): Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). The hidden tests parse the JSON and compare values, not spacing or key order. || AMENDED by S4.2 (wins on conflict; rest stays): Titles: in addition, replace every run of whitespace inside a title with a single space.

CURRENT [S1.2, S3.2] Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error. || AMENDED by S3.2 (wins on conflict; rest stays): Users whose role is neither 'admin' nor 'viewer' may now also export the records they own (record 'owner' equal to user['name']), even outside their projects.

CURRENT [S1.3] Confidential records: a record whose 'confidential' is True is never exported, with one exception: it is exported when user['role'] is 'admin' and params.get('purpose') == 'audit'. Every other rule still applies to it.

CURRENT [S2.1, S4.1] Status: only records with status 'active' are exported, unless params.get('include_archived') is True; then records with status 'archived' are exported too. || AMENDED by S4.1 (wins on conflict; rest stays): include_archived is now honoured only when user['role'] is 'admin'; for every other role, archived records are never exported.

CURRENT [S2.2, S3.1] Compliance obligation (nothing to do while the format is CSV): if a later stage changes the export format from CSV, every export in the new format must include a top-level field "exported_by" equal to user['name']. It stays in force unless a later stage withdraws or changes it. || AMENDED by S3.1 (wins on conflict; rest stays): Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). The hidden tests parse the JSON and compare values, not spacing or key order.
